title: Ballsh refinery workers’ wage-arrears campaign began before October and remained active in October
status: Documented in September and continuing through at least 21 October; endpoint and first qualifying 50+ public action are unknown.
notes: ABC News reports a Ballsh protest on 14 September (S013/S015); VOA describes refinery workers protesting in Tirana by 17 September (S011). Citizens.al dates the hunger strike’s start to 28 September and says ten workers began it (S006), while its 13 October account reports hundreds at the 12 October public march/roadblock (S004). A pre-October crowd of 50+ is not demonstrated, but absence of a count is not zero. The campaign’s episode owner and eventual closure remain unresolved.
